{{Quote|Even while I'm asleep, I always keep my ears up for your calling! If it's you, I'll wake up in a minute!|Abby}}

'''Abby''' {{Lang|zh=阿布}}, initially referred to as "Little One", is an [[NPC]] and the deuteragonist of ''[[Wuthering Waves]]''. It is unknown who and what Abby is, but they felt a familiarity to to the name Abraxas and share a {{Rubi|Convergent Codependency|Symbiotic}}<ref>[[A New Companion]]</ref> relationship with Rover as they reside within [[Rover]]'s [[Tacet Mark]]. 
<!--Please place future revelation within Background and not on top of Page to prevent Spoiling-->
==Profile==
===Appearance===
Abby is a small cat-like Echo with white fur, light brown hands and feet and long ears that serve as wings adorned with golden earrings that match the bracelets Abby wears and the charm on its black collar. Abby additionally has heterochromatic eyes, with the left eye being a light blue and the right eye a vibrant orange with pupils that resemble [[Tacet Mark|Tacet Marks]]. Around its eyes, Abby has pink-orange markings on the outer side of its eyelids and on each cheek as well as another Tacet Mark of the same color on its forehead.

===Background===
The exact identity of Abby is yet to be revealed, only that they have resided within Rover for a long time<ref>[[Legacy of the Lasting Night]]</ref>. Abby is also capable of tracking down strange frequencies and absorbing a large amount of harmful frequencies.<ref>[[Grand Warstorm]]</ref><ref>[[At Dream's Edge]]</ref>. They also help maintain Rover's frequency<ref>[[Flowing Starlight in the Iris]]</ref><ref>[[The Star That Voyages Far]]</ref> and sometimes scold Rover for absorbing "weird stuff". While Abby can manifest when called and stay apart from Rover for a certain amount of time<ref>[[Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands]]</ref>, they cannot maintain their form very long and often have to rest.

Baizhi analysis and Jiyan interview determines Abby is a very rare and highly intellectual Echo, capable of speech and acting out on their own will, which is an uncommon sight in Huanglong. They theorized Abby to being a foreign Echo as there are others places, [[Rinascita]] being one, that have such intellectual Echoes. 
{{Spoiler}}
When encountering [[Jué|Sentinel Jué]] on [[Mt. Firmament]], the Sentinel suggested that Abby might be an entity similar to themselves, even though Jué was not familiar with it.<ref>[[The Commander of Time]]</ref> Abby was also able to remember who [[Iuno]] was<ref>[[By Moon's Fated Light]]</ref>, further proving their bond to Rover.

Abby may also have close connection, and possible past allegiance, with the Threnodians of Solaris-3 with [[Leviathan]] questioning why "Abraxas" has betrayed "us" just before its defeat, but whether or not Abby is also a Threnodian like Leviathan is unknown. It's also unknown if [[Cristoforo]] is aware of Abby's identity.<ref>[[Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides]]</ref>
